name: King's Auto Detailing
description:
King’s Auto Detailing is a professional auto detailing company based in Reidsville, NC, dedicated to delivering high-quality results and exceptional customer care. Owned and operated by Brian King, King’s Auto Detailing takes pride in treating every vehicle with the same attention to detail and respect as if it were our own.

We specialize in interior and exterior detailing, paint correction, ceramic coatings, wax and sealant applications, headlight restoration, and deep interior cleaning. Whether your vehicle needs a routine refresh or a full transformation, we use proven techniques, professional-grade products, and careful processes to achieve long-lasting results—not quick cover-ups.

At King’s Auto Detailing, we believe great detailing goes beyond a clean car. We focus on protecting your investment, enhancing your vehicle’s appearance, and providing honest recommendations tailored to your vehicle’s condition and your goals. No rushed jobs, no shortcuts—just quality workmanship you can see and feel.

From daily drivers to trucks, SUVs, and specialty vehicles, our mission is simple: deliver consistent, high-end results and a customer experience that keeps you coming back.
